articles.headline: Chase Briscoe wins Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Chase Briscoe won Straight Talk Wireless 400 (NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P3 and leading 80 laps. Joey Logano finished second and Alex Bowman was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 10 cautions.

John Hunter Nemechek was the biggest mover, gaining 20 spots from P36 to P16.

Chase Briscoe leads the championship with 1451 points, 215 ahead of Austin Cindric.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
